title: Veilforge
tagline: A duskbound idle RPG of remnant crafts, war-arts, and the last workshop under a broken sky.
overall: Critic-wave shipped as a playable loop: kind-matching icons, quiet job cards with a craft dock, Lantern Quay as its own Shop desk, skill-locked wares dimmed like sold-out stock, and a phone app-shell. Still not a Melvor tutorial. Do not claim Melvor Idle 2 was beaten.

comparison.melvorIdle: Job dock + 1/5/10/25/All batches are closer to a real craft UI; first hour is still thinner than Melvor's gated tutorial
comparison.melvorIdle2: Quay is a place with keepers and hunger, not a sidebar list — completion log and drop-table UI still missing
comparison.runescape: 3D paperdoll, vault inspect, and wanderer kit exist; meshes are still primitive dusk stubs
comparison.oursBetter: Halt overlay, dusk bargains, quay hunger vs vault fence, kind-true item icons
comparison.biggestGap: first-hour teaching vs Melvor's tutorial gate; combat depth; a completion log

pieces.name: One job, Halt overlay
pieces.critic: Halt still the identity. No queue. Phone dock has Halt.

pieces.name: Timber Trawl Vein Ember groves
pieces.critic: Kind icons match logs/ore/fish. Gather loop is intact; Dock Relief is a dusk tax, not a skip.

pieces.name: Hearth Anvil Fletch Loom Sigil Vial
pieces.critic: Quiet cards + craft dock. Anvil: Smelt | Smith. Fletch: Shafts | Bows. Batches halt when the vault runs dry.

pieces.name: Course Whisper Soil Drove Chart
pieces.critic: Identity boards still live. Compost is a toggle. Not a Melvor 2 wow pass.

pieces.name: Vault 3D + Wanderer kit
pieces.critic: Inspect canvas fixed. Phone stacks portrait then slots. Desktop three-column wanderer unchanged.

pieces.name: Lantern Quay shop
pieces.critic: Own Shop desk (not a skill-rail pin). Keepers, dusk bargain, hunger pawn 72% vs vault 40%. Locked tools dim like Auto-Eat, Pay disabled.

pieces.name: Unlock cascade and goals
pieces.critic: Goal bar still points chop → sink. Not a Melvor gated tutorial.

pieces.name: Whole-game connective tissue
pieces.critic: Workshop / Bank / Shop / Wanderer is the map. Phone hides the duplicate ledger. Flavor still outruns teaching.

pieces.name: Fights food triangle specials
pieces.critic: Specials, food chip, duel HUD exist. Depth still trails Melvor. Phone keeps a short scene + Halt in the dock.

pieces.name: Icons, models, paperdoll, dioramas
pieces.critic: Kind atlas first (wood is wood). Unique Imagine cells for monsters/dungeons/pets. PWA veilforge-v18.

pieces.name: Phone and tablet shell
pieces.critic: ≤720px bottom dock; ≤1100px one-column workshop; desktop three-column untouched. 16px inputs, safe areas, back → Workshop.
